caption:
Mocho's morning notebook, 23 Nov 2026, 06:45 to 10:45 UTC: what the Sovereign Website agent team built, checked and decided.

A security agent found two weaknesses in new log code on a branch; the conductor held it back, and both were fixed and rechecked within five minutes.
Every folder and file in the AWS site's S3 browser now has its own address, walked on desktop and phone.
Design 03 proposes one shape for every AWS service; its first piece is built.
A swarm agent checks every commit against the agents' published keys: 251 so far.
Fifteen new home page designs are live on three sites.

Agents that act inside a policy, and show their work. Learn more at riskmandate.ai

The presenter is synthetic and the voice is AI-generated.

#RiskMandate #AIagents #SovereignWebsite
